<strong>Tam yedek</strong> sunucu klasör: A full backup covers the whole server folder, a world backup only the world folders. You can back up while the server is running: the panel first saves the world to disk and pauses autosave until the backup is done. Logs and cache files are not included.
Açıkken her yeni yedekten sonra, sayı sı: When on, the oldest backups are deleted after each new backup once the limit is exceeded; manual and automatic backups both count. When off, nothing is deleted and backups keep piling up.
Geri yükleme sunucu kapalıyken yapılabil: Restoring is only possible while the server is stopped. The panel first backs up the current state, so you can undo a restore too. Backups stay in place even if you delete the server.

Oyuncuların sunucu listesinde, sunucu ad: The short text players see under the server name in their server list. Color codes (§a, §l…) can be used.
How many players can be connected at once. OPs can exceed this limit.
Canavarların verdiği hasarı ve açlığın e: Sets how much damage monsters deal and how hunger affects you. No monsters spawn on Peaceful.
Sunucuya ilk kez giren oyuncuların başla: The mode players start in when they join for the first time.
Açıkken oyuncular her girişte, değiştiri: When on, players go back to the default game mode every time they join, even if it was changed.
Zorluk en yükseğe kilitlenir; ölen oyunc: Difficulty is locked to the highest level; players who die can't respawn and become spectators.
Kapalıyken oyuncular birbirine doğrudan: When off, players can't attack each other directly; indirect damage like traps and lava still works.
Dünyanın nasıl oluşacağını belirleyen sa: A number or text that determines how the world is generated. Left empty, a random one is chosen; only takes effect when the world is first created.
Kapalıyken Nether portalları çalışmaz ve: When off, Nether portals don't work and players can't travel to the Nether.
Zombi, iskelet gibi düşman yaratıkların: Turns natural spawning of hostile mobs like zombies and skeletons on or off.
İnek, koyun gibi hayvanların doğal olara: Turns natural spawning of animals like cows and sheep on or off.
Köylerde köylü doğmasını açar ya da kapa: Turns villager spawning in villages on or off.
Doğma noktasının çevresinde, OP olmayan: Radius around the spawn point where non-OP players can't break or place blocks. Set to 0 to turn protection off.
Kapalıyken havada kalan oyuncular hile ş: When off, players hovering in the air are kicked as suspected cheaters. Turn it on if you use mods or plugins that allow flying.
Komut bloklarının çalışmasına izin verir: Lets command blocks run. Needed for maps and minigames; keep it off if you don't need it.
Oyunculara gönderilen dünya alanının yar: Radius of the world sent to players. Lowering it relieves the server and network the most; 6-10 is enough for most servers.
Oyuncunun çevresinde yaratıkların, ekinl: The area around players where mobs, crops and machines are active. Keeping it smaller than the view distance eases the CPU.
Yaratıkların ve eşyaların oyunculara han: How far away mobs and items are shown to players. Lowering it on busy servers eases the network.
Açıkken dünya her kayıtta diske tam yazı: When on, each save waits until the world is fully written to disk. Turning it off speeds up saving, but the world can get corrupted on a sudden shutdown.
Packets larger than this are compressed. On a local network a higher value eases the CPU; -1 turns compression off.
Oyuncuların gerçek Minecraft hesabıyla g: Verifies with Mojang that players join with a real Minecraft account. If you turn it off, anyone can join under any name — even someone else's, and even get OP rights that way.
Açıkken yalnızca listedeki oyuncular gir: When on, only players on the list can join. You can manage the list in the Players tab on the server page.
Açıkken listeden çıkarılan oyuncu sunucu: When on, a player removed from the list is kicked right away if online; when off, they're only blocked on their next join.
OP'lerin kullanabileceği komutlar: 1 doğ: Commands available to OPs: 1 bypass spawn protection, 2 cheat commands, 3 player management (ban, kick), 4 all commands (including stopping the server).
Bu süre boyunca hareket etmeyen oyuncula: Players who don't move for this long are kicked. Set to 0 to never kick anyone.
